image_description: An industrial scene inside a lumbermill showing three workers standing near a large green band saw machine. The foreground features a worker in a blue shirt and hard hat, while two other workers in protective gear stand behind the machinery. Stacks of rough-cut lumber are visible on the machine bed and in the background. The structure has a corrugated metal roof with exposed wooden beams and slat walls.

The hands of the central worker appear to blend slightly into the red machinery part they are holding/touching, with indistinct boundaries.
The vertical slats in the background show slight waviness and inconsistent spacing, suggesting minor geometric instability.
